title: Swarm Windows installer config.json
description: Human-readable record of resolved install paths, written by the Swarm Windows installer into the install directory. swarm-launch.ps1 reads bashExe and runtimeScriptCygwin; swarm-runtime.sh sources sibling env.sh (the authoritative env source). This schema documents the shape for the Swarm runtime and downstream tooling.

installDir.description: Windows path of the install root (default %LOCALAPPDATA%\Swarm).

cygwinRoot.description: Windows path of the user-local Cygwin root.

venvDir.description: Dedicated Cygwin Python venv (separate from repo .venv).

bashExe.description: Windows path to Cygwin bash.exe. Also written to Pi settings.json shellPath (forward-slash form).

nodeExeCygwin.description: Cygwin POSIX path to node.exe; exported as SWARM_WINDOWS_NODE.

piEntryCygwin.description: Cygwin POSIX path to dist/cli.js; exported as SWARM_WINDOWS_PI_ENTRY.

venvPythonCygwin.description: Cygwin POSIX path to venv/bin/python; exported as SWARM_VENV_PYTHON (used by pi shim and runtime).

venvBinCygwin.description: Cygwin POSIX path to venv/bin; prepended to PATH.

runtimeScript.description: Windows path to static swarm-runtime.sh (copied into install dir).

runtimeScriptCygwin.description: Cygwin POSIX path to swarm-runtime.sh; passed to bash.exe by swarm-launch.ps1.

homeCygwin.description: Cygwin POSIX path to USERPROFILE; exported as HOME so ~/.pi config/auth are reused.

env.description: Authoritative environment variables also written to env.sh (sourced by swarm-runtime.sh). These are the environment values swarm.windows_pi relies on.

HOME.description: USERPROFILE as a Cygwin POSIX path.

BROWSER.description: Shell-quoted browser-open.sh command with a %s URL placeholder (opens Windows default browser).

SWARM_VENV_PYTHON.description: Cygwin POSIX path to the dedicated venv python.
